description_ko: 다리 없이 떠오른 거대한 꽃받침형 몸체. 중앙 꽃 유리함과 하부 태엽축, 개화한 갑주 및 전지가위를 묶은 부유 보스.

references.role: Original Flora identity motifs: teal gardener cap, ivory curls/porcelain, brass hinges, central blue-flower cylinder and pruning scissors; no body/pose lock
Opened shell plates, brass winding drum and teal coiled spring construction; no humanoid anatomy lock

visual_qa.identity: Recognizable cap and swept ivory curls, stern mechanical gardener mask, readable central glass chamber with exactly one blue flower/green stem, ivory/brass/deep-teal palette and one joined pruning-scissors mechanism retained.
visual_qa.silhouette: Zero legs or feet, no insect chassis, no serpent tail. Wide open armored mechanical calyx and short lower winding spindle visibly float above detached oval ground shadow. Upper flower body is substantially broader and less humanoid than normal.
visual_qa.mechanics: Two armored upper arms integrate into calyx. One hand visibly holds upper scissor loop; the opposite forearm/hand is partly occluded by the front calyx and shear mechanism. Two blades share one clear gold pivot. Attached rear winding drum carries two curled deep-teal flat spring strips.
visual_qa.frame: All petal, scissor, spindle and spring tips visible; upper-left spring tip has a narrow intact margin.
visual_qa.method: Full built-in generated image visually inspected; saved PNG decoded as1536x1024 through System.Drawing and exact source copy used. Local view_image sometimes displays only a pale strip despite valid source PNG; generated image preview is normal.
visual_qa.limits: Single-view concept candidate. Not a multi-view reconstruction, rig or selected final design.
